title.purpose: 工具栏月份标题 yyyy年M月。

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: 刷新图标旋转等状态反馈，150–200ms。

components.name: Month Toolbar
components.description: 月历顶栏：翻月、标题、刷新、设置。
components.html: 2026年5月
components.css: .ds-toolbar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; background: #F6F4F0; border-bottom: 1px solid #E5E0D8; font-family: -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-month-title { flex: 1; text-align: center; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; color: #2C2824; margin: 0; } .ds-icon-btn { width: 28px; height: 28px; border: none; background: transparent; color: #6B6560; font-size: 18px; border-radius: 6px; }

components.name: Day Cell Today Ring
components.description: 月历中今天的描边环样式。
components.css: .ds-day-cell { width: 40px; height: 44px; border-radius: 10px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-day-today { border: 2px solid #D44B4F; background: transparent; } .ds-day-num { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: #2C2824; } .ds-day-sub { font-size: 10px; color: #6B6560; margin-top: 2px; }

components.name: Day Cell Holiday Tint
components.description: 法定节假日淡红底 + 右上角「休」字角标。
components.html: 休1劳动节
components.css: .ds-day-cell { position: relative; width: 40px; height: 44px; border-radius: 10px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-day-holiday { background: #F3E4E4; } .ds-marker { position: absolute; top: 5px; right: 5px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; color: #D44B4F; } .ds-day-num { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: #2C2824; } .ds-day-sub { font-size: 10px; color: #D44B4F; margin-top: 2px; }

components.name: Day Cell Makeup Workday
components.description: 周末补班淡蓝底 + 右上角「班」字角标。
components.html: 班6初九
components.css: .ds-day-cell { position: relative; width: 40px; height: 44px; border-radius: 10px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-day-workday { background: #E4ECF8; } .ds-marker.work { position: absolute; top: 5px; right: 5px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; color: #4A7FD4; }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: 月历/设置工具栏无边框图标或文字按钮。
components.css: .ds-icon-btn { width: 28px; height: 28px; border: none; background: transparent; color: #6B6560; font-size: 18px; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 6px; transition: color 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.1, 0.25, 1); } .ds-icon-btn:hover { color: #2C2824; } .ds-icon-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #D44B4F; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: CalendarPlus 是菜单栏里一块安静、信息足的月历玻璃。暖米白底、朱砂红点缀；月历网格承担主叙事，今天在格内用描边环强调。弹窗是单层表面，不靠卡片套娃。
keyCharacteristics: 月历网格为唯一主视图
暖中性浅色为默认精致态
休班用整格淡色底 + 右上角「休」「班」小字
今天用描边环而非整块红底

rules.name: The Warm Neutral Rule
rules.body: 中性色向暖沙偏，禁止冷蓝灰 SaaS 背景。

rules.name: The Semantic Red Rule
rules.body: 红色只表达今天语义、周末、节日、休班。

rules.name: The One Line Detail Rule
rules.body: 每格最多一行副文案，节日优先于农历。

rules.name: The Flat Popover Rule
rules.body: 禁止 card-in-card；深度靠色差与分隔线。

dos: Do 用暖沙 surface 作弹窗根
Do 休班用淡色整格底并配 10px「休」「班」角标
Do 今天在月历格内用描边环强调
Do 使用 SF Pro 与 macOS 原生控件
donts: Don't 做网页风卡片套壳
Don't 照搬 Windows 11 任务栏日历
Don't 使用霓虹深色、玻璃模糊、渐变字
Don't 用三角或色条角标代替「休」「班」文字
Don't 在格内用整块红底表示今天
